comments.author: ODT
comments.body_html:
I agree. But it’s a deliberate decision.

It’s the only universal type of grading that can be done in “slap it and forget it” preset way, that will work in every type of scenario, and in case of Tarkov - every map, be it day or night, any weather condition, any interface element, etc.

That’s why grading is an art form, ideally, like in movies for example, you do it shot-by-shot, scene-by-scene, you consider story, tone and pace, and even music to create the best, and most unique result possible, carefully adjusting everything with secondary masks and spending a lot of time doing it.

But without the ability to adjust everything at every scenario, this is the only way. Is it lazy and somewhat corny from an artistic standpoint? Yeah, kinda, but it’s subjective and debatable. Is it the best rendition of teal-and-orange style possible? I really do think so. Does it make it better and universally more pleasant to look at while serving gameplay purposes? IMO - absolutely.

comments.author: ODT
comments.body_html: To uninstall, run the ReShade installer again, and select uninstall option.
